name: Weaviate
description: Open-source vector database storing objects and vectors with hybrid search.
descriptionZh: 同时存储对象与向量、支持混合检索的开源向量数据库。
keyFact: Weaviate is a BSD-3-Clause vector database written in Go and initiated by Bob van Luijt in 2016; it stores objects and vectors together and supports hybrid (vector plus keyword) retrieval, with a managed Weaviate Cloud offered by the company formerly named SeMI Technologies.
keyFactZh: Weaviate 是用 Go 编写的 BSD-3-Clause 向量数据库，2016 年由 Bob van Luijt 发起；它把对象与向量一并存储并支持混合（向量 + 关键词）检索，其原名为 SeMI Technologies 的母公司另提供托管的 Weaviate Cloud。
